title: What is Embeddings?
description: Embeddings turn text, images, or rows into number lists placing similar meanings together. How vectors are made and used for search.
lead: An embedding is a list of numbers a model computes for a piece of content, placed so that similar meanings sit near each other. Nearby vectors mean nearby meanings, which lets software search by meaning instead of matching exact words. The same vectors group related items, compare passages, and feed the retrieval step behind sourced answers.
